# Fab & Tool Reviews

This site covers independent reviews of welding equipment, fabrication tools, safety gear, and engineering software for workshop professionals.

## Author
- Buyisiwe Vilakazi (qualified boilermaker)

## Website
- https://fabandtoolreviews.com

## Main Topics
- Welding equipment (MIG, TIG, plasma cutters)
- Fabrication tools (measuring, cutting, layout)
- Workshop safety gear
- Engineering software (CAD, design tools)
- Buyer's guides and product comparisons

## Content Philosophy
Honest, hands-on reviews from someone who actually works with metal. Real-world perspective on tools, durability, and cost-effectiveness for tradespeople.
